newsitem.title: ROMANIA: BUCHAREST SHARE PRICES AT NEW HIGHS, RALLY FADING.
newsitem.headline: BUCHAREST SHARE PRICES AT NEW HIGHS, RALLY FADING.

text.p: Most Bucharest share prices on
Thursday touched new highs and turnover climbed to a year high
of 802.9 million lei from 477 million, but the bull run which
has had the market in its grip for weeks has started to wane.
Two independent bourse indices advanced to year highs.
Thursday's turnover was the highest this year and only
second to an all-time record of 1.7 billion lei set four months
after the bourse opened in November 1995.
"It was a pleasure to be in the market today. For the first
time in many months it was highly liquid," said a trader. "But
investors were stuck on Azomures," he added.
Azomures fertiliser maker -- the only stock on the
first tier -- took 87 percent of turnover. Brokers said the
bulk of its deals came from cross trades and a special deal.
Cross trades, allowing a broker to act for both the buyer
and the seller of a security in the same deal, were introduced
last week. The special deal -- a trade struck outside the
market and reported to the bourse later -- involved 4,965
shares at 24,000 lei each, which was also Azomures' close.
Buying also focused on Carbid-Fox SA , Romania's
sole carbide producer, which traded 44,317 shares. It inched
down to a 1,210 lei close.
Artrom SA engineer, seen as the second most
liquid stock, lost ground. Its turnover fell to 16 million lei
from 26 million and it closed 300 lei weaker at 3,350.
Oil drilling company Foraj Sonde SA , suspended on
Tuesday pending a share split, set a reference price of 248 lei
for next Tuesday. The split to 1,000 lei from 25,000 per share
followed oversubscription in a mass selloff last year.
Sanevit SA syringe maker was suspended pending a
statement on adding imported equipment to its capital.
Two unofficial indices - the VAB and the BIG -- rose by 3.8
and respectively 3.25 percent from the previous session.
